```sql
SELECT 
    sum(
        CASE 
            WHEN sol.currency = 'AUD' THEN sol.net_value * COALESCE(fx.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0)
            ELSE sol.net_value
        END
    ) AS answer
FROM staging.stg_erp__sales_order_lines sol
LEFT JOIN staging.stg_erp__fx_rates fx 
    ON sol.order_date = fx.rate_date
WHERE sol.order_date >= '2025-07-01' 
  AND sol.order_date <= '2025-09-30'
```
